messages:
zara (AE): Heads-up: CarePoint sent an RFI asking for a 2-week POC: private deployment into their VPC, BYOH HSM (PKCS#11), 7yr audit retention, target ~80 QPS embeddings and ~40 QPS generation. They want capability matrix, short test plan, and a ballpark quote. Need a draft by EOD tomorrow.
mike (Sales Eng): Copy. Quick clarifiers: region? token lengths? are they ok with a temporary Redwood-managed HSM fallback if BYOH can't be ready day 1?
zara (AE): Region is us-east-1, embeddings ~512 tokens, gen avg 300 tokens. They prefer BYOH but will accept managed as fallback for first 48h.
hana (Solutions): I'll put together the capability matrix mapping their asks to our features: private control plane, VPC peering options, BYOH PKCS#11 support, Redwood-managed HSM fallback, audit retention storage options, and expected performance caveats. Will include attachments: BYOH playbook, sample YAML, and a short test-plan.
lee (SRE): Practical notes for RFI: PKCS#11 over peered network adds ~5-15ms per crypto op; recommend dedicated pool 4x A10x for targets with batching tuned. Peering provisioning typically 24-48h. Audit retention 7yrs ok but include storage/TCO line. Also need to call out HSM ops/sec validation step.
mike (Sales Eng): Preliminary pricing placeholder: 4 GPUs x 2 weeks = $17,500; peering/onboarding = $2,500; SE support (2 days) = $3,200; audit storage delta ~$160/mo. I'll formalize once Hana posts matrix.
hana (Solutions): Draft matrix ETA ~3 hours. Example config snippet I'll include in attachments:
```
# sample private deployment + hsm binding
deployment:
  mode: private
  region: us-east-1
  vpc_peering: true
  hsm:
    interface: "pkcs11"
    endpoint: "tcp://10.0.7.12:7777"
  audit:
    retention_days: 2555  # ~7 years
```
artifact-bot: playbook-uploaded: "byoh-hsm-playbook-v5.pdf" to /internal/playbooks (link: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/byoh-hsm-playbook-v5)
lee (SRE): I'll add a short test-plan to the RFI: validate HSM key ops/sec under load (target 200 ops/sec headroom), measure p95 gen latency at 300 tokens, validate embeddings QPS at 80 under steady-state load, and confirm audit log delivery + retention lifecycle. Also include fallback plan: Redwood-managed HSM using customer key material and note the operational delta.
zara (AE): Perfect. Please drop the draft into /sales/carepoint/rfi-draft and tag me. Procurement asked for a one-page summary for their legal team as well. Thanks all :thumbsup:
